# Workspace AI coding instructions

This workspace contains a 3-hour hackathon agent workflow. When asked to build an idea, read `AGENTS.md`, `START_HERE.md`, and `workflow/3_HOUR_RUNBOOK.md` first. Prioritize a complete, verified MVP and follow the relevant `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md` instructions. Do not fabricate test results or claim mock integrations are live.
